world_photo_atlas.historical_vs_current_environment_attrib: NOT IDENTIFIABLE without independent history/genetics and site-time environment data

quality_sensitivity.definition: primary coarse colour ROI fraction >=0.65; every competing coarse group <=0.20; not a biological morph-validation score

world_photo_atlas.scope: post hoc world-pattern exploration from already-measured original-method photographs; distinct from pre-frozen W test
world_photo_atlas.strongest_allowed_claim: observed photographic flower-colour contrast across sampled taxa/regions with equal taxon weight; NOT real local genetic FCP or unbiased global prevalence

same_species_photo_purity.quality_rule: primary assigned-group ROI fraction >=0.65; all competing groups <=0.20; arbitrary diagnostic, not botanical validation

equal_area_photo_morph_permutation.inference_ceiling: geographic sorting of photographed colour labels only; not genetic population structure or dispersal history
equal_area_photo_morph_permutation.quality_rule: assigned ROI >=65%, all competing coarse groups <=20%; not morph validation

warnings: observational iNaturalist photographs not genetically verified polymorphism
five-cohort same source; no independent provider replication
whiteness pair share is composition-dependent and not W or a global species prevalence
photographic geometric colour differences may include bicoloured flowers and exposure
sampling opportunity and wild/native occupancy remain nonrepresentative
geography does not identify neutral phylogeographic history, and no causal IBE or genetic IBH inferred
photographic quality gate is a posthoc color-content screen not biological validation
